facts.fact_text: On 10 October 2007 the applicant notified the Kazan Town Hall of the intention of a group of dormitory residents to organise a static demonstration.
Between 9 a.m. and 11.30 a.m. on 18 October 2007 a demonstration was held on the pavement close to Svoboda Square.
On 12 October 2007 the Kazan Town Hall refused to approve the demonstration at the proposed location.
At 3.45 p.m. on 18 October 2007 the applicant was forcibly arrested at a bus stop.

The applicant was charged with an administrative offence under Article 20.2 § 2 of the Code of Administrative Offences on account of holding the demonstration in the vicinity of the Constitutional Court of the Republic of Tatarstan.

On 12 November 2007 the Justice of the Peace of the 4th Court Circuit of the Vakhitovskiy District of Kazan convicted the applicant of breaching the established procedure for conducting public assemblies under Article 20.2 § 2 of the Code of Administrative Offences.

On 16 November 2007 the Justice of the Peace of the 5th Court Circuit of the Vakhitovskiy District of Kazan convicted the applicant of disobeying a lawful order of the police under Article 19.3 § 1 of the Code of Administrative Offences.

On 12 November 2007 the Justice of the Peace of the 4th Court Circuit of the Vakhitovskiy District of Kazan convicted the applicant of breaching the established procedure for conducting public assemblies under Article 20.2 § 2 of the Code of Administrative Offences.

On 16 November 2007 the Justice of the Peace of the 5th Court Circuit of the Vakhitovskiy District of Kazan convicted the applicant of disobeying a lawful order of the police under Article 19.3 § 1 of the Code of Administrative Offences.

The Kazan Town Hall stated that heavy road traffic and a car park for government vehicles would put the participants' security in danger, as the reason for refusing to approve the demonstration at the proposed location.
On 12 October 2007 the Kazan Town Hall refused to approve the demonstration at the proposed location.
The Kazan Town Hall proposed that the demonstration be held inside the park at Svoboda Square.
On an unspecified date the applicant notified the authorities that he disagreed with the proposal to change the location of the demonstration.
At 3.45 p.m. on 18 October 2007 the applicant was forcibly arrested at a bus stop.

The applicant was charged with an administrative offence under Article 20.2 § 2 of the Code of Administrative Offences on account of holding the demonstration in the vicinity of the Constitutional Court of the Republic of Tatarstan.

On 12 November 2007 the Justice of the Peace of the 4th Court Circuit of the Vakhitovskiy District of Kazan convicted the applicant of breaching the established procedure for conducting public assemblies under Article 20.2 § 2 of the Code of Administrative Offences.
The Supreme Court of the Republic of Tatarstan concluded that there had been no lawful grounds for arresting the applicant.

The Supreme Court of the Republic of Tatarstan found that there were no grounds for finding the applicant guilty of committing the administrative offence of disobeying a lawful order of the police under Article 19.3 § 1 of the Code of Administrative Offences.

On 26 June 2008 the Novo-Savinovskiy District Court of Kazan, relying on the judgment of the Supreme Court of the Republic of Tatarstan of 11 January 2008, established that in forcibly arresting the applicant, the police officers from the Kazan Town Police Department had acted unlawfully, in the absence of legitimate grounds.
